title: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. This mismatch can produce accurate rendered masks from incomplete 3D selections since alpha-blended feature supervision concentrates learning on dominant contributors while leaving occluded or low-contribution Gaussians weakly supervised. We propose VODA, a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to group per-pixel contributors and directly supervises all Gaussians in selected depth clusters, bypassing contribution-weighted gradient delivery. To evaluate volumetric completeness, we introduce Removal-3D, a synthetic object-removal benchmark, and the Removal Depth Error (RDE), a metric comparing predicted and ground-truth depth changes. Across four rendering-based baselines, VODA consistently improves volumetric segmentation on Removal-3D

translated_title: 掩码并非对象：面向3D高斯分割的体积监督
translated_abstract: 3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）能够在高斯基元上实现对象级操作，然而现有的分割方法大多通过渲染视图进行训练和评估。这种不匹配可能导致从不完整的3D选择中产生看似准确的渲染掩码，因为alpha混合特征监督将学习集中在主导贡献者上，而使被遮挡或低贡献的高斯基元得不到充分监督。我们提出VODA，这是一种即插即用的监督目标，它利用局部深度结构对逐像素贡献者进行分组，并直接监督所选深度簇中的所有高斯基元，从而绕过基于贡献加权的梯度传递。为了评估体积完整性，我们引入了Removal-3D（一个合成对象移除基准测试）以及移除深度误差（RDE，一种比较预测与真实深度变化的指标）。在四个基于渲染的基线方法上，VODA在Removal-3D上一致地提升了体积分割性能。
tldr: 针对3D高斯分割中渲染视图监督导致3D选择不完整的问题，本文提出即插即用的VODA监督目标，利用局部深度结构直接监督所有高斯基元，从而实现体积上更完整的3D高斯分割。
en_tdlr: VODA is a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to directly supervise all Gaussians in depth clusters, achieving volumetrically complete 3D Gaussian segmentation beyond merely accurate rendered masks.
